changelog:
Huawei Cloud Monitoring Query Skill 1.0.1

- Clarified that only local Python scripts within the skill directory are supported for all queries; direct CLI or API use is strictly prohibited.
- Detailed supported features: querying alarm rules, histories, templates, dashboards, notification masks, resource groups, one-click alarms, and enterprise project information (list, detail, quotas, resource bindings, migration records).
- Listed strict usage and result output principles to avoid unsupported queries, unreliable responses, or unsafe operations.
- Expanded prerequisites and environment setup instructions, with mandatory environment check script usage before any query.
- Outlined workflow: environment check, guide-based script selection, dry run with -h, followed by targeted query execution.
- Clearly stated that only CES (Cloud Eye) and EPS (Enterprise Project) services are supported; queries for other services are not permitted.
summary: Queries Huawei Cloud monitoring and enterprise project resources (CES/EPS). Covers alarm rules, alarm histories, alarm templates, dashboards, notification masks, resource groups, one-click alarms, and enterprise projects (list/detail/quotas/bound resources/migration records). No write operations. Use this skill when the user needs to check alarm status, view monitoring dashboards, query alarm rules, or manage enterprise project info. Triggers include: 云监控, 告警, 告警规则, 告警历史, 仪表盘, 企业项目, CES, EPS, 告警模板, 资源分组, alarm, monitoring, alert.
